mcqs.question: Under the MSME classification applicable from July 1, 2020, which description correctly applies to a medium enterprise?
options: Investment up to ₹50 crore, turnover up to ₹250 crore; all MSME loans are priority-sector loans
Investment up to ₹250 crore, turnover up to ₹50 crore; all MSME loans are priority-sector loans
Investment up to ₹50 crore, turnover up to ₹250 crore; MSME loans are not priority-sector loans
Investment up to ₹250 crore, turnover up to ₹50 crore; MSME loans are not priority-sector loans
mcqs.explanation: A medium enterprise is defined by investment of up to ₹50 crore and turnover of up to ₹250 crore. All MSME loans are classified as priority-sector loans; the tempting alternative reverses the investment and turnover limits.
